name: Companies House register (home address removal)

search.notes: Only relevant if the person is or was a company director, secretary, LLP member or person with significant control. Old filed documents can show a home address, full date of birth or signature.

steps: Search the officer register and list every filed document that shows the home address, day of birth or signature.
If the address is the current correspondence address of an active officer, file a replacement address first.
If the home address was the company's registered office, change the registered office first. For a dissolved company wait 6 months.
Complete form SR01 from the GOV.UK guidance page.
Pay 34 pounds for each document listed, as the form explains.
Post the application to The Registrar of Companies, PO Box 4082, Cardiff CF14 3WE.
Wait for the Companies House decision notice.
optout.notes: This costs money, 34 pounds per document as of the page update dated 1 February 2026. Companies House gives no time for individual applications. Copies already taken by third-party company data sites are not removed, so check those separately.

sources.attribution: GOV.UK, removing your personal details from the Companies House register
